translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Tito
book.title: Kart daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao Títona'

content: Na' li' ṉaa, bli' bsedi beṉ' daa nak dii ḻi.

Bzajnii beṉ' golka' gakgake' beṉ' nsa' c̱heyin wen, beṉ' chidoḻ' gap beṉ' ḻegake' balaaṉ, beṉ' nyeeṉ nyeeniyi, na' soac̱hec̱hgake' gonḻilall'gake' Crístona', na' gakgakile' beṉ', na' so sakgakile' bittez dii yen ile'gakile'.

Ḻekzka' nool golka' chiyaḻ' gall illebgake' Chioza', na' bi gakzgake' beṉ' wic̱hitj dill', ni bi we'gake' latj gonzə yeḻ' weezona' ḻegake' gan, san chiyaḻ' gongake' wen kwenc̱he ile'i beṉ' ka chiyaḻ' gongake'.
Na' wli' wsedgakile' nool xkwid'ka' gaki beṉ' c̱he'ka' na' gaki xiiṉe'ka',

na' gakgake' beṉ' nyeeṉ nyeeniyi, beṉ' bi nda' nchen dii mal, na' gap wwia ḻoo yoo lillgake', gakgake' beṉ' chiyesh'lallii, na' wḻex̱j yic̱hjgake' lao beṉ' c̱he'ka' kwenc̱he kono iṉe zban c̱he xtill' Chioza' ni c̱hegake'.
Na' ḻekzka' goll bi' wew'ka' gakgakb' bi' nyeeṉ nyeeniyi.
Li'yeṉ'an chiyaḻ' wli'o chono' wen lao yog'ḻoḻte daa chono'. Na' wsa' c̱ho' bash bal kat' wli' wsedilo' beṉ' na' benan do yic̱hj do lalloo,
na' wsako' wi'o dill' kwenc̱he bibi de iṉa beṉ' c̱heyin. Na' yido'i beṉ'ka' chakzbani cho' daa bibi de gon iṉagake' c̱hecho.
Bzajnii beṉ'ka' yoo x̱anin wḻex̱j yic̱hjgake' lao x̱ane'ka', na' gongake' ka yiyoolall'gake', na' bi yilliizgake' ḻegake' dill'.
Na' bibi si' kwangake' c̱he x̱ane'ka', san soa do lall'gake' kwenc̱he wli'gake' lao yog'ḻoḻ daa chongake' nan ḻe wen nak cho'a xtill' Chioza', beena' bisla cho' kwenc̱he bi kwiayi'cho.
Chioza' ba bliile' yog'ḻoḻ beṉ' yeḻ' goklen c̱he'na' kwenc̱he yilagake' na' bi kwiayi'gake'.

Na' yeḻ' goklenna' daa bene' c̱hecho chli' chsedin cho' kwej yic̱hjcho daa bi nak wen na' diika' chzelall' beli chenna', na' soacho yell-lioni nyeeṉ nyeeniyicho, goncho ka chiyoolall' Chioza', na' gall illebchone',
shlak noncho lez illin lla choo lla xenna' yila' Jesucrístona', beena' nak beṉ' choo beṉ' xen, na' nake' Chios c̱hecho na' bisle' cho.
Ḻen' bzani yeḻ' mban c̱he'na' ni c̱hecho kwenc̱he bisell biḻee cho' lao yog'ḻoḻ dii mala', na' bix̱is biyibe' cho' kwenc̱he gakcho lall' nee na' selall'cho goncho daa nak wen.
Dgan chiyaḻ' wli' wsedilo' beṉ', na' wtipo' lall'gake' gongake' ka cheeni Chioza', na' wsheshleno' beṉ'ka' bi chon wen, na' benan ḻega beṉ' nzoa Chioza'. Na' kono chiyaḻ' gonzi li' nakzi.
